# Hot-path baseline — the blocking calls reachable from tick/tick20ms/tick1s today.
#
# Generated by `uv run moondeck/check/check_nonblocking.py --baseline`. Format is
# `<file>\t<callee>`; `#` starts a comment. Keyed on file+callee, NOT line, so an entry
# survives edits above it.
#
# THE CRITERION IS ABSOLUTE, NOT THIS LIST. A call with no guard runs on every tick, and
# the target for those is zero: the check prints that count first, and needs no list to
# judge it. This file only separates a known site from a new one for the GUARDED calls,
# where whether the hot path reaches it at all is a judgment per site.
#
# Keyed on (file, callee), so MOVING a file voids every entry for it. That happened: a
# directory reshuffle left fourteen paths pointing at nothing and every finding read as
# new, which is indistinguishable from a real regression. The check now names a dead path.
#
# A line here means KNOWN AND BACKLOGGED, not acceptable — see backlog-core.md
# 'move blocking work off the render callbacks'. The list only shrinks: move the work
# off the render path, delete the line. Adding a line means admitting a new blocking
# call on the render path, which is what this exists to prevent.
